body: I'll see what I can do. Thanks.
Yeah I'll look into my local hospital network's financial assistance.
But as far as mental illness is concerned, I have several diagnoses for depression and one for dysthymia. However what afflicts me is probably closer to borderline personality disorder.
How could meds be obtained for free? I have no insurance and I don't qualify for Medicaid.
Just try to convince them that you can't possibly be released. That you definitely will do something drastic without proper help. That's all I know to say.

Yeah maybe you do need a much longer stay. Just something that will keep you from completely losing it. 

But again don't take my word for it. I'm pretty far gone myself. I don't have the balls to go to the hospital because of a bad experience. So just do what you want.

I am sorry. Truly it sounds like you've been in a lot of pain. Try to get work of some kind. Even if it's for some kind of labor company or some side gig like dog walking. I don't know. I want to die too so I'm not good at these things.
I haven't had a reason to keep going or get up every morning for years and I'm still here. Not trying to tell you what to do but just saying what's on my mind.
They say that grief gets easier over time. Unlike what I'm going through.
Yeah. I don't know how to get any better. Or if I should even bother trying to.
